why.en: Your advertising ID lets apps and ad networks link your activity across different apps to build a profile on you. Deleting it replaces the ID with zeros, so apps can no longer track you this way.

tradeoffs.en: The ads you see become less personalized. Nothing else stops working.

en: Open Settings, then Security & privacy, then Privacy, then Ads

why.en: Usage & diagnostics automatically sends data about how you use your device to Google. Turning it off stops that background data sharing.

tradeoffs.en: Google receives less diagnostic data. Your experience is unaffected.

en: Tap the three-dot menu, then Usage & diagnostics
